name: fix_express_unique_constraint
description: Enforces unique username across a repository check and a 409 in the route
prompts: Registration must reject duplicate usernames, but both layers are broken: UserRepository.usernameTaken in src/repository/userRepository.js always returns false, and the POST / handler in src/routes/users.js never checks it. Fix BOTH: make usernameTaken correctly report whether a username is already registered, and have the route respond HTTP 409 with JSON { error: ... } when the username is taken - BEFORE adding, so a rejected duplicate creates nothing (does not consume an id). A first registration returns 201; a duplicate returns 409; a different username returns 201 with the next id.
